# Accuracy {scrolling="true"}

## Row {height=80px}

::: {.card}
Backtest: rolling out-of-sample forecasts, each made without that day's prices, but made afterwards, plus the live days so far.
The live forecasts are on the [main page](index.html).
:::

## Row {height=450px}

```{r}
#| title: "Accuracy"
if (has_eval) {
  acc <- eval_acc
  if (!is.null(mcs_models)) acc <- left_join(acc, mcs_models, by = "model")
  acc |>
    transmute(Model          = unname(long_labels[model]),
              `MAE (€/MWh)`  = round(mae, 1),
              `RMSE (€/MWh)` = round(rmse, 1),
              `rMAE`         = round(rmae, 3),
              `In MCS (10%)` = if ("in_mcs" %in% names(acc)) ifelse(in_mcs, "yes", "") else "") |>
    knitr::kable(align = "lrrrr")
}
```


## Row {height=720px}

::: {.card title="Is the difference significant?"}

Rolling out-of-sample forecasts, `r eval_period`, all models on the same hours.

`r acc_txt` `r sig_txt` `r live_txt`

```{r}
if (has_eval) {
  real_m  <- eval_acc$model[!grepl("^naive", eval_acc$model)]
  naive_b <- eval_acc$model[grepl("^naive", eval_acc$model)][1]
  others <- setdiff(c(real_m, naive_b), real_m[1])
  bind_rows(lapply(others, \(o) {
    r <- find_test(eval_tests, real_m[1], o)
    if (is.null(r)) NULL else mutate(r, model_a = real_m[1], model_b = o)
  })) |>
    transmute(Comparison    = paste(long_labels[model_a], "vs", long_labels[model_b]),
              `MAE diff`    = round(mae_diff, 2),
              `DM p`        = p_tab(dm_p),
              `GW p`        = p_tab(gw_p),
              `Hours better / worse` = paste(hours_a_better, "/", hours_b_better)) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "lrrrr")
}
```

:::


# Ranges {scrolling="true"}

## Row {height=440px}

::: {.card title="Ranges: how honest are the probabilities?"}

```{r}
#| output: asis
tab_attr <- 'class="table table-sm table-striped small"'
if (has_prob) {
  tab1 <- prob_m |>
    arrange(pinball) |>
    transmute(Method                = paste0(unname(q_methods[method]), ifelse(chosen, " (used)", "")),
              Pinball               = round(pinball, 2),
              `Skill vs naive`      = if ("skill" %in% names(prob_m)) pct(skill) else "\u2013",
              `DM p vs best`        = ifelse(is.na(dm_p), "best", p_tab(dm_p)),
              `50% range covers`    = sprintf("%s (p %s)", pct(cov50), p_tab(cov50_p)),
              `90% range covers`    = sprintf("%s (p %s)", pct(cov90), p_tab(cov90_p)),
              `Width 50% / 90% (€/MWh)` = sprintf("%.1f / %.1f", width50, width90),
              `Calibration error`   = round(cal_error, 3))
  cat(knitr::kable(tab1, format = "html", align = "lrrrrrrr", table.attr = tab_attr))
  cat("\n\n", prob_txt, " ", neg_txt, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (!is.null(prob_cal)) {
    tab2 <- prob_cal |>
      filter(model == eval_main, tau %in% c(0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.95)) |>
      mutate(tau = paste0(round(100 * tau), "%"), below = pct(below)) |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tau, values_from = below) |>
      transmute(`Share of prices below the quantile` = unname(q_methods[method]), across(ends_with("%")))
    cat(knitr::kable(tab2, format = "html", align = "lrrrrrrr", table.attr = tab_attr))
  }
}
```

## Row {height=44%}

```{r}
#| title: "Cumulative battery profit when planning with each forecast (EUR)"
if (!has_battery) {
  cat("Run scripts/11_battery.R to add the battery backtest.")
} else {
  p3 <- plot_ly(bat_daily, x = ~date)
  for (s in intersect(names(long_labels), names(bat_daily))) {
    p3 <- p3 |>
      add_lines(y = cumsum(bat_daily[[s]]), name = long_labels[[s]],
                line = list(color = strat_colors[[s]], width = if (grepl("^naive", s)) 1.5 else 2.5,
                            dash = if (s == "perfect") "dot" else "solid"),
                hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:,.0f} €<extra>", long_labels[[s]], "</extra>"))
  }
  p3 |> chart_layout() |> layout(legend = list(orientation = "v", x = 1.02, y = 1), margin = list(t = 20))
}
```

## Row {height=42%}

```{r}
#| title: "Profit by strategy"
if (has_battery) {
  bat_sum |>
    transmute(Strategy              = unname(long_labels[strategy]),
              `EUR per MW per year` = prettyNum(eur_per_mw_year, big.mark = ","),
              `Share of perfect`    = pct(share_of_perfect),
              `MAE (€/MWh)`         = ifelse(strategy == "perfect", "", format(round(mae, 1), nsmall = 1))) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "lrrr")
}
```

::: {.card title="How it works"}

Each day a `r bat_desc` plans tomorrow on the forecast and is paid the actual prices, over `r bat_period`.
Perfect foresight plans on the actual prices.

`r bat_txt`

No fees or battery wear.

:::

```{r}
#| title: "Battery revenue each day and its 95% floor (€)"
if (!has_risk) {
  cat("Run scripts/12_battery_risk.R to add the revenue at risk.")
} else {
  rd <- risk_daily |> filter(method == risk_u$method) |> arrange(date)
  plot_ly(rd, x = ~date) |>
    add_lines(y = ~realized, name = "Revenue", line = list(color = orange, width = 1.5),
              hovertemplate = "%{y:,.0f} €<extra>Revenue</extra>") |>
    add_lines(y = ~floor, name = "95% floor (expected minus VaR)", line = list(color = "#2563eb", width = 1.5),
              hovertemplate = "%{y:,.0f} €<extra>95% floor</extra>") |>
    add_markers(data = filter(rd, miss), y = ~realized, name = "Below the floor",
                marker = list(color = ink, size = 8, line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 2)),
                hovertemplate = "%{y:,.0f} €<extra>Below the floor</extra>") |>
    chart_layout() |>
    layout(margin = list(t = 20))
}
```

## Row {height=250px}

```{r}
#| title: "Backtest: four ways to build the scenarios"
if (has_risk) {
  risk_tests |>
    transmute(Method                        = paste0(label, ifelse(used, " (used)", "")),
              `Days below the floor`        = sprintf("%s (%d of %d)", pct(miss_rate), misses, days),
              `Kupiec p`                    = p_tab(kupiec_p),
              `Christoffersen p`            = ifelse(is.na(christoffersen_p), "\u2013", p_tab(christoffersen_p)),
              `Acerbi–Székely p`            = p_tab(z2_p),
              `FZ0 score`                   = format(round(fz0, 2), nsmall = 2),
              `DM p vs best`                = ifelse(is.na(dm_p), "best", p_tab(dm_p)),
              `VaR / ES (€)`                = paste(sapply(var, eur), "/", sapply(es, eur)),
              `Live misses`                 = ifelse(live_days > 0, sprintf("%d of %d", live_misses, live_days), "\u2013")) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "lrrrrrrrr")
}
```

## Row {height=360px}

::: {.card title="How it works"}

Past days' 24-hour errors, run through the day's plan, in four ways: as they were (60 days), scaled by
last week's price volatility, a normal distribution, and scaled by an EWMA of recent errors (up to 250 days).

Rule set before running: pass Kupiec, Christoffersen and Acerbi–Székely at 5%, then the lowest FZ0 score.
EWMA was added after the first three failed, so the live days are its real test.

`r risk_txt`

No fees or battery wear.

:::
